1.name: Abu Nour
1.t: A kind spirit who holds the lighthouse light and brings the lost back.

2.name: The Three Spirits
2.t: They are said to have lived in the apartment the wall flew off from.

3.name: Memory of the Sea
3.t: A city sank, and the lake still remembers it.

4.name: Uncle Shehata
4.t: A boatman whose tongue is longer than the canal.

5.name: Umm Saad
5.t: Her voice rises from the simsimiyya and draws people in.

6.name: The Empty Pedestal
6.t: A base waiting for a statue that never came back.

7.name: The Three Domes
7.t: They count the ships entering the canal.

8.name: Colors of Glass
8.t: A ceiling that used to tell in colors.

9.name: Master of the Continents
9.t: He stamps the passport in ten minutes between two continents.

10.name: Lady of the Balcony
10.t: She knows all the old street names.

11.name: Remember
11.t: The story that can't be made up.

12.name: Book of the Strait
12.t: The fishermen write it with the net.

13.name: The Horse That Pulls
13.t: A horse that never arrives but never stopped.

14.name: Sabah the Dove
14.t: She carries greetings from the lighthouse.

15.name: The Black Flag
15.t: Hung when the sea turns dangerous.

17.name: Letter to Whoever Will Come
17.t: A letter that has not arrived until now.

19.name: One of One Hundred and Two
19.t: A mosque out of 102 of the same style.

20.name: The Grain of Wheat
20.t: The granary that had a minaret on top.

22.name: Madame Nagwa
22.t: A mannequin who remembers all the customers.

24.name: The Open Door
24.t: A painting that kept looking at the door.

25.name: The Land That Was Made
25.t: A city built from dredge sand.

26.name: Bag of Sugar
26.t: Saved a banquet for six thousand.

27.name: Uncle Quarn
27.t: The only building before the city.

28.name: The Lock That Wasn't Locked
28.t: A lock on the promenade whose key is in the canal.

29.name: Fatma
29.t: A tilapia with a name in the market.

30.name: The Flag
30.t: Raised in the morning after the night of December 23.

31.name: Salt Mountain
31.t: White as snow and salty in taste.
